description: This horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the percentage breakdown of three distinct components across two main categories. The vertical axis contains the categories, ordered from bottom to top, with the bottom category labeled "Standard" and the top category label obscured by a solid grey rectangle; there is no explicit vertical axis label. The horizontal axis represents the value in percentages, though it lacks an explicit axis label, scale line, tick marks, or tick intervals; however, the stacked bars each sum to a total of 100%. The bars are stacked horizontally, with each color-coded segment representing a different component as defined by the legend at the bottom: blue represents "Context", orange represents "Generated Response", and green represents "Other". Exact percentage values are annotated directly onto each segment. For the bottom "Standard" category, the bar consists of a 23.6% blue segment, a 51.1% orange segment, and a 25.3% green segment. For the top category with the redacted label, the bar comprises a 60.6% blue segment, a 31.7% orange segment, and a 7.7% green segment, which is the shortest segment in the chart. The bars do not appear to be sorted by any specific numerical value, as both total 100%, but the top category label is visually emphasized through its redaction with a grey box.
